analysis.summary: Rivals are pushing hard on switching pages and customer stories. TaxCloud is mostly refreshing old pages while Kintsugi, Zamp and Numeral publish at a much higher volume.

points.text: Numeral has a "TaxCloud Alternative" page, part of 12 alternatives pages, and 61 of its 93 pages are aimed at buyers.
TaxCloud published 58 pages against 95 the month before, and 50 were updates, while Kintsugi and Zamp ramped up.
Avalara and TaxJar mostly teach, with 60 of 74 and 67 of 77 pages aimed at learners, and Avalara has just 1 case study.

TaxCloud.play: Refreshing old pages. Mix of rival comparisons and 16 customer stories, plus Avalara-risk news.

Avalara.play: Teaches through webinars and state nexus (where you owe tax) pages. Almost no customer proof.
Avalara.aimed: Learners, Shopify, QuickBooks and enterprise users

TaxJar.play: Mass-refreshed 58 state guides: shipping taxability, marketplace laws, due dates. Little comparison content.

Anrok.play: SaaS-first. 17 case studies, California SaaS tax 2027, e-invoicing, Stripe tie-ins. Fewer pages than before.

Numeral.play: Sales-page heavy. 23 case studies and 12 "alternative" pages naming TaxCloud, Avalara and others.

Zamp.play: Huge scale: 116 comparison pages, pricing breakdowns of TaxJar and Avalara, a buyout offer.
Zamp.aimed: Brands switching from TaxJar or Avalara

Kintsugi.play: 49 new pages, mostly state how-tos, plus alternatives pages for Avalara, Anrok, Numeral, Vertex, Zamp.
Kintsugi.aimed: Searchers comparing tools and state rules

shared.title: Switch-from-rival pages
shared.text: TaxCloud has 19 comparison pages, Numeral 12, Kintsugi 22 and Zamp 116. Everyone is fighting for the same switcher. Numeral targets TaxCloud by name.

shared.title: Customer proof at scale
shared.text: TaxCloud has 16 case studies, Anrok 17, Zamp 21, Numeral 23. Proof is standard, so TaxCloud needs stories that stand out, like Craft-e-Corner after Avalara.

shared.title: State-by-state guides
shared.text: Avalara (nexus pages), TaxJar (shipping taxability), Kintsugi and Zamp publish state pages in bulk to catch tax-rule searches. TaxCloud's 105 /sales-tax/ pages compete here.

gaps.title: TaxCloud vs Numeral and Zamp
gaps.text: TaxCloud compares itself with Anrok and Kintsugi, but not Numeral or Zamp, who both target its buyers. Own the head-to-head before they do.

gaps.title: Step-by-step switching guide
gaps.text: No company here publishes a full migration playbook with timeline, filing handoff and data moves. Only Zamp's buyout offer comes close. Own the low-risk switch.

gaps.title: Mid-market proof
gaps.text: Numeral and Zamp show small direct-to-consumer brands, and Anrok shows startups. Stories with real revenue size, states and platform count could own the mid-market buyer.
